# ChasteBusinessOS

> Open-source, AI-native business operating system for governed operations. People, agents, and workers use one capability pipeline: permission-checked, policy-gated, recorded in an append-only audit ledger, and reversible where a capability declares an inverse.

ChasteBusinessOS is an agentic ERP for finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, projects, CRM, customer support, documents, people operations, and analytics. It is built with a React and Vite client, Go APIs and workers, and PostgreSQL with pgvector.

## Public entry

- [Sign in](/login): the public entry to a workspace.
